Arc cannon.notes: Heavy (1), Critical (7+). Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Arc claw.notes: Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Arc grenade.notes: Grenade, Blast (4), Indirect. Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Arc maul.notes: Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Arc pistol.notes: Pistol. Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Arc rifle.notes: Rapid Fire, Critical (7+). Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Eradication ray (atomising beam).notes: Heavy (1), Beam. This weapon cannot target models that are further away than its Rng value.

Eradication ray (diffused beam).notes: Heavy (1), Blast (3). This weapon cannot target models that are wholly within 9" of the bearer.

Grav-cannon.notes: Heavy (1). Successful hits with this weapon are resolved with Dm 2 if the value for the hit roll was greater than the target’s armour save, or Dm 3 if the hit roll was double the target’s armour save or more.

Grav-pistol.notes: Pistol. Successful hits with this weapon are resolved with Dm 2 if the value for the hit roll was greater than the target’s armour save, or Dm 3 if the hit roll was double the target’s armour save or more.

Guardian skull.notes: Familiar (6+). When the bearer makes a ranged attack, they can only attack with this weapon if they are firing defensively.

Hydraulic claw.notes: Critical (7+). Attacks with this weapon incur a hit roll penalty of 1.

Krak grenade.notes: Grenade, Critical (7+). The bearer can only make a melee attack with this weapon if the target is Large (2 or greater).

Magnarail lance.notes: Heavy (1). This weapon has the Critical (6+) type if the bearer does not move in the same phase.

Mechadendrites.notes: The bearer can attack with this weapon as an additional secondary weapon, using its normal A value instead of an A value of 1.

Melta bomb.notes: Grenade. This weapon can only target models that are Large (2 or greater). If the target is a Machine that did not move in the previous Manoeuvring Phase, the hit is always successful.

Mindscrambler grenade.notes: Grenade, Blast (4), One Use. A model (enemy or friendly) hit by this weapon reduces their BS and CS values by D4 until the end of the round and their Ld value by D4 until the end of the game. Roll separately for each characteristic, and for each model hit.

Phase taser.notes:
Critical hits additionally inflict two AP 0 hits on the same model. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, once the attack has been fully resolved, roll a D8 for each model or unit (excluding Large models) that was allocated one or more successful hits from this weapon. On a 3+, that model or unit may be placed anywhere on the battlefield that is within 12" horizontally and 3" vertically of their previous position and more than 1" away from any of your models. They cannot be placed off the ground and made to fall.
If the target is a unit and not every model in the unit was hit by this weapon, the value required to move that unit is 7+ instead of 3+.

Power fist.notes: Critical (6+). Attacks with this weapon incur a hit roll penalty of 1.

Quantum annihilator.notes: Heavy (1), Critical (7+). If a model is reduced to 0 remaining life by an attack from this weapon, they gain the Explodes! ability. If they already had an Explodes! ability, they instead add 1 to the roll to see if they explode.

Rad-cleanser.notes: Assault, Engulf (2), Radiation (2+). If this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a model, that model gets two Radiation tokens instead of one for that hit.

Servo arm.notes: Critical (7+). The bearer can attack with this weapon as an additional secondary weapon. Attacks with this weapon incur a hit roll penalty of 1.

Servo pincer.notes: The bearer may use any number of servo pincers they are armed with as additional secondary weapons. A model armed with any servo pincers has the Repair (3+, this model) ability.

Skull of the Electromartyr.notes: Familiar (6+), One Use. When the bearer attacks with this weapon, they make D2 hit rolls against every enemy model within 4″. Each time this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

Taser goad.notes: Critical hits additionally inflict two AP 0 hits on the same model.

Taser lance.notes: Polearm. Critical hits additionally inflict two AP 0 hits on the same model.

melee.notes: Polearm, Critical (6+). The bearer may only attack with this weapon if they charged in the same round. Critical hits additionally inflict two AP 0 hits on the same model.

Torsion cannon.notes: Heavy (1), Critical (7+). If the bearer makes a successful hit roll with this weapon, they can immediately make another attack against the same target − this second hit roll is only successful if the value rolled is greater than the first hit roll. They can repeat this process until it is no longer possible to make a greater successful hit roll.

Transonic cannon.notes: Heavy (1), Engulf (3), Stun (5+). If the target model is within 5", this weapon has the Stun (2+) type.

Volkite blaster.notes: Rapid Fire. If this weapon inflicts a critical hit on a model, that model and each model within 2" of them (enemy and friendly) gets a Flame token.

Arc-shock implants.notes: When this model makes a saving throw against a melee attack, if the value rolled is 8+, the attacking model suffers one AP 3 hit. When this model is destroyed, each model within 1" of them (enemy and friendly) suffers one AP 3 hit.

Cantic thrallnet.notes: Visible friendly Skitarii and Servitor models within 9" of this model must use this model’s BS, CS and Ld values instead of their own. In addition, for the purpose of the Mindlock ability, while this model is on the battlefield all friendly Servitors treat it as if there were a friendly Tech-priest on the battlefield.

Cogitator engine.notes:
When this model is set up on the battlefield, choose a Canticle of the Omnissiah (excluding the Catechism of the Divine Chorus). For the duration of the game, this model benefits from that Canticle in addition to whichever Canticle is in effect for the warband that round. If this model’s chosen Canticle provides the same effect as the Canticle that is affecting the warband, that effect applies to failed rolls of 1 or 2, instead of just rolls of 1.
Every model in the warband with this item must choose the same additional Canticle.

Cognis weapon.notes: When you create your warband, choose one ranged weapon this model is armed with (excluding Grenades). When this model makes a ranged attack with the chosen weapon, they ignore any penalties that are the result of faltering, panicking or firing defensively.

Consecrated bionics.notes: This model improves the value for their Ignore Damage ability by 1.

Corpus cybernetica.notes: This model has the Heal (2+, Skitarii) ability.

Cyber-occularis.notes: When this model, or any visible friendly Adeptus Mechanicus model within 3″ of them, makes a ranged attack, they ignore the effects of enemy Stealth abilities. Additionally, if any of these models trigger a trap, roll a D8: on a 6+ the trap is disarmed, and its effects are ignored.

Energy shield.notes: This model has the Shield ability, and they improve their invulnerable save by 1 (if this model does not have an invulnerable save, they instead gain an 8+ invulnerable save).

Enhanced data-tether.notes: While this model is on the battlefield, friendly Skitarii models improve their Ld value by 1.

Experimental field-test.notes: When you create your warband, choose one ranged weapon this model is armed with (excluding Grenades). The chosen weapon improves its AP and Dm values each by 1, incurs a critical hit bonus of 1 for the duration of the game and gains the Overheat (1) type (if this weapon already has the Overheat type, instead add 1 to the number of injuries it inflicts when it overheats).

Extensive self-augmentation.notes:
When this model is set up on the battlefield, roll two D4s and apply the corresponding improvements below to this model’s characteristics:
Add 1" to their ordinary Mv value and 2" to their advancing Mv value.
Improve their BS or CS value by 1 (your choice).
Add 1 to their Lf value.
Choose one of the improvements above to apply to this model.

Frequency resonator.notes: When you create your warband, choose one weapon this model is armed with that has ‘arc’, ‘taser’ or ‘electro’ in its name. The chosen weapon gains the Critical (7+) type.

Induction actuators.notes: This model adds 4" to their advancing Mv value.

Infoslave skull.notes: Add 1 to your control score for an objective if this model is within 3" of it, even if this model is non-scoring.

Logister cortex.notes: This model has the Infiltrate ability.

Mag-suspensors.notes: This model ignores the effects of the Heavy (1) type for any weapons they are armed with.

Neural jammer.notes: If this model charges, enemy models cannot fire defensively at them, and enemy models and units within 1" of them in the following Close Quarters Phase fight last in that phase.

Rad-censer.notes: At the beginning of the Resolution Phase, roll a D8 for each model (enemy and friendly) that is within 1" of this model: on a 3+, that model gets a Radiation token.

Refractor field.notes: This model has a 7+ invulnerable save.

Reinforced exoskeleton.notes: Reduce the Dm value of each successful hit inflicted on this model by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

Scryerskull.notes: Once per round, if you have one or more models with scryerskulls on the battlefield, you may re-roll a single dice roll. When you make this re-roll, roll two dice and choose the result you prefer.

Skull-probe.notes: When this model is set up on the battlefield, place a Skull-probe marker at a point on the battlefield wholly within 12" horizontally of this model. For the remainder of the game, enemy models arriving from reserve or using the Infiltrate ability cannot be set up within 9" horizontally of the Skull-probe marker. When making measurements involving a Skull-probe marker, always measure from the centre of the marker.

Stasis field.notes: This model has a 2+ invulnerable save. Each time this model moves or makes an attack, they lose this invulnerable save until the end of the round. In the Close Quarters Phase, if this model is still benefiting from their stasis field that round, they may choose not to attack.

Thorium rounds.notes: When you create your warband, choose one ranged weapon this model is armed with that has the Radiation type (excluding Grenades). Improve the value for this weapon’s Radiation type by 2.

Titanium-weave warplate.notes: This model improves their armour save by 1.
